defects_argued.quote: The inaction and the state of inertia which prevailed thus leads us to the inevitable conclusion that the respondents clearly failed to discharge their obligation within a reasonable time.

outcome.quote: Resultantly, the present petition is allowed and the impugned OIA dated 31.01.2025, OIO dated 27.06.2024 and SCNs dated 17.04.2013, 07.05.2014, 20.04.2015, 10.05.2016 and 19.03.2018, are quashed and set aside.
